tools.name: list_monitors
tools.description: Listeaza toate monitoarele OmniWatchGuard ale userului autentificat, cu numarul de schimbari din ultimele 7 zile si ultima schimbare detectata.

tools.name: get_monitor
tools.description: Returneaza detaliile complete ale unui monitor si ultimele 20 de rezultate de verificare.

tools.name: create_monitor
tools.description: Creeaza un monitor nou pentru o pagina web. Tipuri uzuale: text, price, stock, visual, css, api, seo. Numarul de monitoare si frecventele disponibile depind de planul userului.

tools.name: update_monitor
tools.description: Actualizeaza campuri ale unui monitor existent: nume, url, selector, frecventa sau praguri de pret/stoc.

tools.name: set_monitor_status
tools.description: Pune pe pauza sau reactiveaza un monitor existent.

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: Listeaza ultimele notificari trimise userului (email, webhook, slack, discord, telegram), cu detalii despre schimbarea care a declansat fiecare alerta.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_alerts · Public sink: list_alerts · Destructive: delete_monitor.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_alerts · Public sink: list_alerts · Destructive: delete_monitor

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
